description: Auditor General's Department - Amendment of Minute on the Sri Lanka  Audit Examiners' Service Published in the Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 380/61 of 20.12.1985
categorisation: This gazette content involves an amendment to the Sri Lanka Audit Examiners' Service regulations by the Public Service Commission, specifically regarding examination marking criteria. This falls under public sector administration and service conditions, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content deals with public service examination procedures and efficiency bar requirements, which aligns with Type 8's focus on "Public service recruitment and examinations" and "Service conditions and benefits."
